items.quote: Firecrawl is the context API for AI agents. Search, scrape, and interact with the live web to get clean Markdown or structured data.
items.why: Quote states context API for agents, search/scrape/interact, clean Markdown or structured data.

items.quote: The header should contain `Bearer fc-123456789`, where `fc-123456789` represents your API Key.
items.why: Quote covers only the Bearer API key part, not the full list of auth methods.

items.quote: To let users connect their own Firecrawl account to your app instead, use OAuth for apps.
items.why: Quote states OAuth lets users connect their own account, but not the full auth method list.

items.quote: Firecrawl gives you 1,000 free credits every month, which covers about 1,000 pages, and no card is required.
items.why: Quote gives free credits and no card needed; does not mention self-serve credential gating or key issuance.
